name: Continence
overview: Scripture emphasizes the virtue of continence through examples of self-control and faithfulness, as seen in Joseph's refusal of his master's wife's advances despite temptation (Genesis 39:7) and his obedience to God's command to take Mary as his wife without consummation until after Jesus' birth (Matthew 1:24-25). The commitment to purity is further underscored by the resolve to guard one's thoughts, as expressed in Job's covenant with his eyes to avoid lust (Job 31:1). These passages collectively highlight the biblical call to uphold sexual integrity and honor God's design for marriage and holiness.
